section.label: ROX File Search is a separate GTK3 process. It follows the system GTK theme and can search one or several selected directories without increasing the normal memory use of Rox-Filer2.

frame.label: Applications for MIME types
Applications associated with the selected MIME type are shown directly at the top of the file menu, preserving the classic ROX tools workflow.

Open With reads installed .desktop files, GIO and ~/.config/mimeapps.list. It also scans the real XDG application directories when a distribution has no updated MIME cache. Folders are handled as inode/directory.
User applications are stored below ~/.local/share/applications and their icons below ~/.local/share/icons. Rox-Filer2 obtains the real paths from GLib for the active user.
Actions for files and directories
Create commands for files, directories or symbolic links. Matching actions appear beside the MIME applications in the foreground of the contextual menu.
Actions are stored below ~/.local/share/rox-filer/actions and can be limited by MIME type and by single or multiple selection. Historical OpenWith and SendTo directories are not read.
